investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint downloads (3,450 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 12) was observed from Tiina.Koppel@globalcorp.ee, originating from Klaipeda, Lithuania at 05:05 local time. The account is listed as Head of Research & Development, but the user agent indicates scripted (Python aiohttp) access and sampled files include highly sensitive IP, encryption keys, finance, and M&A documents that extend beyond a narrowly scoped R&D need; no recent related events or similar alerts were found. Given the scale of downloads, automated access pattern, and presence of sensitive documents outside expected R&D boundaries, this activity is classified as High Priority because it represents a credible data exfiltration risk requiring further investigation.
